title: Scalable AI Uncertainty Quantification via Generalized Laplace Active Subspaces
abstract: arXiv:2610.11738v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reliable uncertainty quantification (UQ) is essential for deploying neural networks in scientific and high-stakes applications, but full Bayesian inference over the network parameters is computationally infeasible. We propose a low-rank generalized Laplace approximation for neural-network UQ based on a small number of data-informed curvature directions. Starting from a generalized Bayesian posterior defined through an empirical loss, we construct a local Gaussian approximation around a pretrained set of weights in this active curvature subspace. The posterior variances in the retained subspace are available in closed form, and the prior variance is calibrated by an empirical Bayes procedure. translated_title: 通过广义拉普拉斯主动子空间实现可扩展的AI不确定性量化
translated_abstract: 可靠的不确定性量化（UQ）对于在科学和高风险应用中部署神经网络至关重要，但对网络参数进行完整的贝叶斯推断在计算上是不可行的。我们提出了一种基于少量数据驱动曲率方向的低秩广义拉普拉斯近似方法，用于神经网络的不确定性量化。从通过经验损失定义的广义贝叶斯后验出发，我们在该主动曲率子空间中围绕预训练的权重集合构建局部高斯近似。保留子空间中的后验方差具有闭式解，先验方差则通过经验贝叶斯程序进行校准。广义贝叶斯公式使我们能够比较两种后验缩放方式：与求和负对数似然相关的标准贝叶斯缩放，以及将经验损失按数据点数量进行归一化的平均损失缩放。
tldr: 提出一种基于少量数据驱动曲率方向的低秩广义拉普拉斯近似方法，通过闭式后验方差和经验贝叶斯先验校准，实现了神经网络可扩展且高效的不确定性量化。
en_tdlr: A low-rank generalized Laplace approximation built on a few data-informed curvature directions enables scalable neural-network uncertainty quantification through closed-form posterior variances and empirical Bayes prior calibration.
